# EAI CLI Documentation

> Build vertical business applications with the EnterpriseAI platform CLI.

## Overview

The EAI CLI (`@eai-tools/cli`) lets developers scaffold, seed, deploy, and manage vertical business applications on the EnterpriseAI platform. Install with `npm install -g @eai-tools/cli`.

## Getting Started

- [Installation](/eai-cli/getting-started/installation/): Install via npm, npx, or from source
- [Quick Start](/eai-cli/getting-started/quickstart/): Get running in 5 minutes
- [Authentication](/eai-cli/getting-started/authentication/): Device code flow with Entra CIAM
- [Your First Vertical](/eai-cli/getting-started/first-vertical/): Build a complete app from scratch

## Guides

- [Object Types](/eai-cli/guides/object-types/): Define data models with properties, links, actions
- [Resources](/eai-cli/guides/resources/): CRUD operations and querying
- [Environment](/eai-cli/guides/environment/): Sync cloud config to local development
- [Deployment](/eai-cli/guides/deployment/): CI/CD and Azure App Service deployment
- [AI Features](/eai-cli/guides/ai-features/): Chat, documents, and RAG integration
- [Multi-Tenant](/eai-cli/guides/multi-tenant/): Tenant management and data isolation
- [Security](/eai-cli/guides/security/): Authentication, roles, and access control
- [Troubleshooting](/eai-cli/guides/troubleshooting/): Diagnostics and common issues

## Concepts

- [Platform Overview](/eai-cli/concepts/platform-overview/): What is EnterpriseAI?
- [Verticals](/eai-cli/concepts/verticals/): Industry-specific business applications
- [Architecture](/eai-cli/concepts/architecture/): CLI → Platform API → Services
- [Data Model](/eai-cli/concepts/data-model/): Object Types as core abstraction
- [Security Model](/eai-cli/concepts/security-model/): Roles, tenants, and permissions

## Command Reference

- [eai init](/eai-cli/reference/commands/init/): Scaffold a new vertical
- [eai login](/eai-cli/reference/commands/login/): Authenticate with the platform
- [eai env](/eai-cli/reference/commands/env/): Environment variable management
- [eai types](/eai-cli/reference/commands/types/): Object Type operations
- [eai resources](/eai-cli/reference/commands/resources/): Resource CRUD
- [eai tenant](/eai-cli/reference/commands/tenant/): Tenant management
- [eai chat](/eai-cli/reference/commands/chat/): AI chat operations
- [eai docs](/eai-cli/reference/commands/docs/): Document operations
- [eai deploy](/eai-cli/reference/commands/deploy/): Deployment workflows
- [eai verify](/eai-cli/reference/commands/verify/): Connectivity checks
- [eai whoami](/eai-cli/reference/commands/whoami/): Auth status
- [eai dev](/eai-cli/reference/commands/dev/): Local development server

## Reference

- [Object Type Schema](/eai-cli/reference/object-type-schema/): Complete schema specification
- [API Surface](/eai-cli/reference/api-surface/): Public API endpoints
- [Environment Variables](/eai-cli/reference/environment-vars/): Configuration reference
- [Error Codes](/eai-cli/reference/error-codes/): Error reference and troubleshooting
- [Glossary](/eai-cli/reference/glossary/): Platform terminology

## Code Examples

- [TypeScript](/eai-cli/examples/typescript/): Platform SDK and fetch patterns
- [Python](/eai-cli/examples/python/): requests/httpx patterns
- [C#](/eai-cli/examples/csharp/): HttpClient patterns
- [Java](/eai-cli/examples/java/): HttpClient (Java 11+) patterns
- [Go](/eai-cli/examples/go/): net/http patterns
- [Rust](/eai-cli/examples/rust/): reqwest patterns
- [Shell](/eai-cli/examples/shell/): curl and jq patterns
